Welcome to the College of Relationship & Marriage (CORM). We are a trusted global community where faith meets practicality. We equip individuals, couples, and organizations with the knowledge, skills, and spiritual support needed to build thriving, God-centered relationships and marriages.

OUR FOUNDATION / 01

Healthy relationships start with healthy individuals.

We are not a dating platform. We are a purpose-driven community focused first on personal growth, equipping people to walk confidently in their God-given purpose whether single or married. We believe healthy relationships begin with healthy individuals, so we start with identity, character and purpose before we ever talk about partnership.

THE WORK WE DO

Built on three pillars.

A deliberate approach to relational health: teaching that grounds you in truth, resources that equip you for the journey, and counselors who walk alongside you toward clarity and restoration.

01

Relationship advocacy & public education

Preventative teaching rooted in sound doctrine, before and after vows are exchanged.

02

The structured resource engine

Practical knowledge made accessible through a growing collection of foundational publications.

03

Professional, confidential mediation

Thoughtful access to seasoned counselors for clarity, healing and restoration.

03

OUR CORE SERVICES

Our Core Services.

A full spectrum of faith-centered support — from confidential counseling and personalized coaching to certification programs, live events, resource publishing and institutional partnerships — designed to strengthen relationships at every stage.

Relationship & Marriage Counseling

Pre-marital, marital, & post-marital counseling.

Coaching & Mentorship

Personalized coaching for singles, couples, and families.

Training & Certification Programs

Courses and certifications for relationship coaches, marriage counselors, and mentors.

Seminars, Workshops & Retreats

Interactive events for singles, couples, and leaders focused on love, courtship, and marriage enrichment.

Media & Resource Development

Books, manuals, video teachings, and digital content on relationships and personal development.

Institutional Partnerships

Counseling and training support for churches, schools, ministries, and organizations.

04

MOMENTS

Gatherings, events & meetings.

We have hosted diverse events both online and in person — conferences, seminars, church services, and gatherings in corporate, academic and religious settings across Ghana. Our online meetings reach a global community.

We also host an end-of-month online gathering called LOVE CAFE — a relaxed, conversation-driven meeting spanning relationship and marriage topics, self-development, career, business, finance and purpose advancement. Tap any photo to view it larger.
